Class 5A playoff preview: four area teams in Opening Round
Four area teams play in Class 5A Opening Round games this weekend, and according to our projections, two games will be competitive and one will be a blowout.
Four area teams play in Class 5A Opening Round games this weekend, and according to our projections, two games will be competitive and one will be a blowout.
The top eight seeds in each of the North and South brackets of the 48-team Class 5A field have byes in the Opening Round, and the other 32 teams play Friday and Saturday, Oct. 23-24.
Winners advance to the First Round on Saturday, Oct. 31.
We call a game competitive if our projection has it decided by 10 points or fewer and a blowout if the margin is 21 points or more.
Antioch, the No. 1 seed in the North bracket, has a bye and plays the winner of No. 16 Glenbard South and No. 17 Payton in the First Round.
Wauconda, the No. 4 seed in the North bracket, has a bye and plays the winner of No. 13 Senn and No. 20 Lakes in the First Round.
Opening Round schedule and predictions
Friday, Oct. 23
- 6 p.m.: North: No. 18 St. Francis (4-5) at No. 15 Grayslake North (5-4) (St. Francis 41, Grayslake North 14)
- 7 p.m.: North: No. 19 Grayslake Central (4-5) at No. 14 Deerfield (5-4) (Deerfield 30, Grayslake Central 24)
Saturday, Oct. 24
- 2:45 p.m.: North: No. 20 Lakes (4-5) vs. No. 13 Senn (5-4) at Winnemac Stadium (Lakes 28, Senn 27)
Game Capsules
No. 19 Grayslake Central (4-5) at No. 14 Deerfield (5-4)
Grayslake Central travels to Deerfield in the Class 5A Opening Round, and the winner plays No. 3 King (7-2) in the First Round.
Kickoff is 7 p.m. Friday.
The projected winner, Deerfield, would face Chicago Public Schools team King in the First Round, and with CPS teams 9-105 against non-CPS opponents in the playoffs over the five seasons through 2025, a win here is essentially a berth in the Second Round.
#14 Deerfield (5-4)
Deerfield (5-4) is the No. 14 seed in the 48-team Class 5A field and hosts No. 19 Grayslake Central in the Opening Round.
Deerfield went 5-4 overall and 2-1 in Central Suburban (Central), scoring 197 points and allowing 220, an average margin of -2.6 a game.
Deerfield went 1-8 and missed the playoffs last season. Deerfield has reached the playoffs in five of the last 10 seasons.
